title: The /join account check is throttled per mailbox as well as per IP, as sign-in is

source.ref: Scan nine (2026-10-19 weekly meta scan), docs/META-SCAN-STATUS.md

detail: joinEmailHasAccount (SCAN-906) answers anonymously, and silently, whether an address has an account. Its only throttle was 30 per 10 minutes per IP, three times sign-in's, with no per-mailbox bucket, so a walker rotating IPs could probe one address without limit; sign-in also mails a link on every probe, which makes it noisy, while this does not. It now also takes the per-mailbox bucket join:email-check:mail at sign-in's 4 per 10 minutes. Still open and filed separately: the check walks auth users page by page (SCAN-1013).

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const s=fs.readFileSync('app/join/(induction)/actions.ts','utf8');const i=s.indexOf('export async function joinEmailHasAccount');const b=i<0?'':s.slice(i,i+1500);if(!/rateLimitOk\\('join:email-check:mail', address,/.test(b)){console.error('SCAN-1007: the /join account check is throttled per IP only');process.exit(1)}"
